champion.tips: KOG'MAW TIPS AND TRICKS Farm up a storm during the early game and limit trading up until you have your first item. Then look to play hyper-aggressive once it is complete. Try and go for extended trades rather than short trades with the enemy as Kog’Maw can melt champions with the additional range and stats from his W . As Kog’Maw is very squishy and can easily die if he’s caught out, use Living Artillery R to check bushes instead of face checking them.
champion.builds: THE BEST KOG'MAW BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR MID IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Kog'Maw Mid build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Arcane Comet as your keystone, followed by Manaflow Band, Absolute Focus and Scorch in the primary tree, as well as Cut Down and Presence of Mind in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Luden's Companion as your first item, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes and Shadowflame. For your last 3 items, you should build Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff and finish with Morellonomicon. For the skill order, you want to stick with E - Q - W. Right now, this build has 53.0% winrate over 249 matches played. Optional Your second option for Kog'Maw Mid build would be to take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Arcane Comet as your keystone, Manaflow Band, Absolute Focus and Scorch in the primary tree, and Cut Down with Presence of Mind in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense. The items for the build are Malignance, which you should build first, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item and Archangel's Staff as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Shadowflame, Void Staff and Rylai's Crystal Scepter. The skill order for this build is E - Q - W. In the current patch, this build has a 48.1% win rate over 79 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Lethal Tempo as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Bone Plating with Overgrowth in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Health Scaling, and Health as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Wit's End as your first item, then Boots as a second item and Guinsoo's Rageblade as a third item. You want to finish the build with Runaan's Hurricane, Randuin's Omen and Kaenic Rookern. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it W - Q - E. This build is currently sitting at a 49.2% win rate across 61 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Kog'Maw Mid build in the current patch, try Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, First Strike, Cash Back, Triple Tonic and Cosmic Insight as your primary rune tree, and Presence of Mind with Cut Down as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Luden's Companion as your first item, then finish Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item, and Shadowflame as third item. The last 3 options are Rabadon's Deathcap, Malignance and Horizon Focus. The ability order for this build is E - Q - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 58.3% win rate over 60 matches played. Situational Kog'Maw Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Kog'Maw build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Kog'Maw runes page.
